jobs.title: Project Manager, Gaming Localization Production
jobs.description: About the Role We're looking for a Project Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of a large-scale localization program for a multinational gaming publisher. This customer ships localized content across dozens of titles, platforms and languages, and the program spans in-game text, marketing and UA content, cinematics and trailers, and supporting print and digital collateral. You'll act as a key operational point of contact for the account, coordinating linguists, DTP and video specialists, and internal stakeholders to hit release-critical deadlines. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who has managed localization programs for a game publisher before and is comfortable owning complex, multi-workstream schedules under tight deadlines. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden ConTech-Scale-ups Europas revolutionieren wir den Einkauf und die Nachunternehmervergabe. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature.

As part of our Commercial Team, we're building our B2C growth engine from the ground up. We're launching new customer acquisition channels, experimenting with new products, and continuously working towards product-market fit. We are looking for a Product Engineer who works at the intersection of product, engineering, and growth. In this role, you will develop and launch digital products, build and test MVPs, and implement technical solutions that improve customer acquisition. What you’ll do 1. Build & Launch Digital Products Build customer-facing applications, landing pages and conversion funnels to support B2C growth. Rapidly develop, launch, and iterate on MVPs to test hypotheses and validate new product ideas. Design and run data-driven experiments to measure performance and continuously improve customer acquisition. 2. Drive Product & Growth Work closely with C-Level Members and the Commercial Team to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and increase conversion rates. Translate commercial needs into product requirements and prioritize initiatives based on business impact

jobs.title: Board Test Engineer
jobs.description: About the job Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy. Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing. Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems. Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms. Understanding of automated optical inspection (AOI) and automated X-ray inspection (AXI) capabilities. Ability to diagnose electronic defects to component level. jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive
jobs.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role Every product launch, promo and market entry at LemFi reaches customers through a campaign. As Senior CRM Executive, you'll build and ship them: email, push, in-app and SMS, across remittance, credit, savings and whatever we launch next. You take a brief and turn it into a live, tested, correctly targeted send - then tell us what it did. You'll report to the Senior CRM Manager for Campaigns and work daily with Growth Managers, Product Marketing, Design and Compliance. This is a hands-on role with a high volume of sends and a high bar for getting each one right, because a wrong rate, a broken link or the wrong segment lands in a customer's pocket. Do it well and you'll be the person the rest of the business trusts to get their message out. What you'll build and own Build and launch campaigns end to end in our marketing automation platform: segments, content, scheduling and send. Turn campaign requests from across the business into clear builds, and push back when a brief doesn't hold up. QA every send before it goes: targeting, personalisation, links, localisation and compliance sign-off. Run A/B tests on subject lines, timing, offers and channels, and feed what wins into the next campaign. Keep the campaign calendar honest so customers aren't hit by five messages in one day. Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills. Fluency in English and at least one other European language. A bachelor's degree. Nice to have. Experience working EU, Global NGO’s, European, GCC (Middle East) UK Governments, An advanced degree.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels. Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques. Ton rôle chez Dastra À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes. Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients. En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision. Tes missions Qualifier les besoins techniques : conduire les phases de Technical Discovery , analyser les environnements IT des prospects et échanger avec leurs interlocuteurs techniques (DSI, RSSI, équipes IT), en complément de la qualification business réalisée par les Sales. Démontrer la valeur de Dastra : concevoir des environnements de démonstration personnalisés, construire des cas d'usage pertinents et animer des démonstrations adaptées aux enjeux métiers et techniques des clients. Piloter les Proof of Concept (POC) : définir les critères de succès, organiser les validations techniques et apporter les preuves concrètes de l'adéquation de notre solution aux besoins du client. Sécuriser les cycles de vente complexes : répondre aux questions d'architecture, d'intégration, de sécurité et de configuration (SSO, API, interconnexions, MCP...) et lever les objections techniques des prospects. jobs.title: AI Engineer H/F - Paris
jobs.description: AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ? AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital , créée en 2007. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Data Engineering, IA générative et LLM. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour faire de la Data un véritable levier de transformation. Nous intervenons auprès de clients aux secteurs d’activité variés, sur des missions qui combinent enjeux techniques, Data, IA et transformation opérationnelle. Selon votre profil et vos affinités, vous pourrez contribuer à des projets allant de la conception de prototypes jusqu’à la mise en production de solutions IA robustes, sécurisées et maintenables. Nos clients évoluent notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, des Télécoms, de la Banque, de l’Assurance et de l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques techniques variées. Quelques exemples de projets AI Engineer Conception et développement d’agents autonomes pour automatiser des processus métiers : conception de workflows complexes, notamment dans l’industrie ou la relation client, dans lesquels des agents IA enchaînent des tâches, prennent des décisions et interagissent avec les outils et les données internes de l’entreprise. Conception et orchestration de plateformes multi-agents : mise en place d’architectures dans lesquelles plusieurs agents IA spécialisés collaborent pour résoudre des problématiques complexes, par exemple en combinant recherche d’informations, synthèse et exécution de code, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle. jobs.description: Stage Software Development Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou! Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Bouw jij mee? Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: Backend development; Frontend development; Embedded Software Development; DevOps; Security; Software testing. Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: Python; C++; Rust; Angular; Typescript; Playwright; Zabbix; Linux; MariaDB; Kubernetes; SALT. Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten? jobs.title: Stagiair Business Control
jobs.description: Ben jij er klaar voor om impact te hebben op een van de belangrijkste sectoren in de wereld? Bij IXON connecten wij machines met hun makers. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Hier krijg jij energie van Tijdens deze stage van een half jaar (startende in februari) ga je aan de slag met de uitrol van Business Control binnen onze R&D-afdeling, waar dit op dit moment nog niet aanwezig is. Wij geloven dat het geluk van de mens hem zit in het hebben van autonomie, een doel (purpose) en de kans om te groeien. Business control heeft daar een enorme impact op! Doordat de behaalde resultaten zichtbaar worden, kunnen deze gevierd worden en zie je direct hoe je zelf presteert en groeit binnen het bedrijf. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business! Hoewel geen dag hetzelfde is, houd jij je tijdens een gemiddelde werkweek onder andere bezig met de volgende activiteiten: De bestaande rapportagestructuur en kosten binnen de R&D-afdeling in kaart brengen; Het maken van een concreet uitrolplan (waaronder het bepalen van KPI's, rapportages en reviews); Meehelpen met rapportageverbeteringen en overkoepelend meekijken op de afdeling; Wanneer er tijd is: een pilot draaien met één van onze teams om jouw theorie in de praktijk te brengen. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijnt

jobs.title: Senior AI Solution Specialist
jobs.description: Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still building those solutions yourself? As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group , you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while helping shape how we use AI across the organisation. You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security. This is a hands-on senior role . Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. It doesn’t mean stepping away from the technology. You’ll still design, prototype and build. Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office) Start Date: December/ January Availability : Fulltime Your impact Lead complex AI discovery. Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype. Build AI solutions. Design and develop agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. Shape enterprise AI initiatives. Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful. Je werkt in een omgeving waar innovatie de standaard is en waar jouw code direct invloed heeft op hardware, sensoren, controllers en real-time verwerking. jobs.description: Analyseren, (functioneel) testen, debuggen… Waar houd jij je als test engineer bij ons eigenlijk niet mee bezig!? Als test engineer is iedere werkdag anders. De complexe producten die wij maken voor onze klanten, maken gebruik van proces- en functionele testers. Uitval hiervan wordt geanalyseerd en testers worden gedebugged. Dit wordt in samenwerking met ons Test Development team gedaan, die onze testers hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd én vrijgegeven. Het grootste gedeelte van je werkdag ben je bezig met praktische en analytische werkzaamheden. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als test engineer: Testen van prototypes: in een losse testopstelling op je werkbank meten. Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester. Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen. Reparatie van uitgevallen producten; uitval na o.a. AOI, Flying probe of functionele testers of retouren vanuit de klant. Interne overleggen: bijvoorbeeld met je collega’s van de afdeling Quality, Engineering etc. Technisch challengen : niet alleen bij Benchmark collega’s, maar soms ook bij de klant. Jij zorgt in alles wat je doet voor de juiste analyses en verwerking hiervan. Hierdoor worden afwijkingen gefilterd en gesignaleerd, worden root-causes vastgesteld en opgelost en blijft het productieproces continu verbeteren. Wat biedt Benchmark? jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Ben jij een Senior Quality Engineer die verder kijkt dan het oplossen van afwijkingen? Iemand die kwaliteit ziet als een stuurinstrument en het voortouw neemt in structurele verbetering? Dan bieden wij jou een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt. Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten. Wat ga je, onder andere, doen? Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen. Leiden van root cause analyses en borgen van effectieve, duurzame CAPA’s. Initiëren, ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteitsstandaarden, procedures en werkinstructies. Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en doelgericht benutten van interne en externe audits. Analyseren en vertalen van kwaliteits‑KPI’s naar concrete verbeteracties en besluitvorming. Regie voeren op kwaliteit binnen NPI‑projecten, inclusief kritische beoordeling van deliverables en klantspecificaties. Waar maak jij het verschil? Je werkt intensief samen met productie, engineering, supply chain en klanten, maar neemt vooral ook inhoudelijk leiderschap. Je stelt de juiste vragen, doorbreekt reactieve patronen en helpt de organisatie om kwaliteit voorspelbaar, robuust en toekomstbestendig in te richten. Binnen het team krijg je ruimte om verbeterinitiatieven te initiëren, anderen daarin mee te nemen en samen te bepalen waar jouw expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt. Kortom: een rol voor een professional die eigenaarschap

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
jobs.description: About Cellsor Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that. We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring. We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering). About the role As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months. What you will do: Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation Test and iterate with our Boston biology team Contribute to grant applications What you need to succeed Must-have: MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week Fluent English; German a plus Nice-to-have: Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics Gas handling or air sampling S

jobs.title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it. About the Role As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath. Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows. You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together.

jobs.title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer (all identities)
jobs.description: Das erwartet Dich Build intelligent backend systems that make a genuine impact in healthcare. Caspar Health is the leading digital platform for medical rehabilitation. We empower doctors, therapists, and nursing staff to care for patients as quickly, effectively, and sustainably as possible. To take our platform to the next level, we are expanding our small, highly agile backend squad (consisting of 3 engineers and a Product Manager). In this role, you will take full technological ownership: from designing robust Ruby on Rails services and clean API architectures to building LLM-based agent workflows with repeatable quality checks. If you are passionate about combining modern AI engineering with true purpose and highest software standards, you will thrive here. We appreciate your expertise and wish to provide full transparency regarding the compensation range for this role. Your starting salary will be aligned with your qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and market benchmarks. Remuneration for this position follows our internal salary bands and ranges from €78,000 to €88,000 gross annually (based on a full-time 40-hour work week). This role is located in Germany and requires full physical presence within the country. Due to our existing payroll and social security framework, permanent remote employment from abroad is not supported. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany and resident from their first day. Please be advised that we cannot offer visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time. Deine Herausforderungen • System Architecture: Full end-to-end ownership of your features across implementation, automated testing, release, and live operation. • Backend Engineering: Development of scalable Ruby on Rails services, robust APIs, data models, and background jobs including authorization and billing workflows. • LLM Workflows: Building and optimizing LLM applications, evaluation pipelines, and agent workflows with repeatable quality checks

jobs.description: We're looking for an Account Executive to close new-logo business for Cytix in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet. You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads, which means the pitch has to work on its own merits rather than on brand recognition. This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle. You'll carry mid-market opportunities to start, working alongside SDR-sourced pipeline as well as your own prospecting, with a clear path to Senior Account Executive as your quota, deal complexity and independence grow. What you'll do Run full-cycle new-logo opportunities from qualified meeting through discovery, demo and close, sourced by SDR, Marketing and your own prospecting. Generate some of your own pipeline alongside SDR support, prospecting into a clearly defined ideal customer profile. Terraform and Kubernetes that stand up a new region repeatably, with explicit regional config and visible drift. Cross functional stakeholder management. jobs.description: About FoodLabs FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up.
